soldier: Small soldier with body colour as in the large form. Head circular and slightly long, longer than wide; nasus a stout cone, shorter than the head, directed straight forwards in profile with the tip distinctly lower than the top of the head, the base of the nasus slightly arched, the angle between nasus and head about 105°. Antennae 12 segments, the second the shortest, the third longer than the second, the third and fourth nearly equal. Anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum both nearly straight.
